name_en: Shoyu mame — koji-fermented soybeans steeped in raw soy sauce
summary_ja: 麹で発酵させた大豆に米麹を合わせ、生醤油に漬け込んで1ヶ月以上熟成させる北信・中信地域の発酵食品。「食べる醤油」ともいわれ、香川県のそら豆を使う同名の料理とは全く別物だという。
summary_en: Soybeans fermented with koji are combined with rice koji, steeped in raw soy sauce, and aged over a month — a fermented food of northern and central Nagano sometimes called 'edible soy sauce,' entirely unrelated to the Kagawa dish of the same name made from fava beans.
source_title: しょうゆ豆／しょうゆの実 長野県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
